title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1999 3.8.2 Of the 38,272 total victims who were murdered, 9294 victims have been done to death by fire arms. Of these, 772 fall victims to Licensed fire arms and 8522 persons were dead due to un-licensed fire arms. The States of Uttar Pradesh (4754) and Bihar (2402) reported the highest number of such victims at All-India level. The above 2 states shared around 77.0% of the total victims murdered by fire arms in 1999.
